page.layout: One column of index entries, text left with page numbers at the right; a Hebrew word on the Messiae line; a Hebrew word with a boxed sign on the qvid line; a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: edidit librum de Patriarcharum & Primatum origine. | 5
cum Joh. Buxtorfio in amicitiam venit. | 73

page.notes: The Hebrew word after "Messiae nomen apud Samaritanos" is read as השהב and is doubtful. The Hebrew word before "qvid." is doubtful, and a dark box stands beside it. The number after "ad" on the Morinus line is uncertain (read as 105). The page numbers "IIO" and similar are copied as Arabic numerals as they appear. No running head or page number is printed. The "liber" at the foot is taken as a catchword. A stroke at the top right is not transcribed.
